_comment: One shape, every source. SharePoint, Drive, Confluence, Git and ServiceNow each express permission differently; the index cannot filter on five dialects. Attach this to every CHUNK, not just every document.
_design_rules: Absent fields DENY, never allow. A null classification that evaluates as 'unclassified' is a fail-open policy engine.
Deny beats allow. This is where home-grown policy code most often has a bug.
The descriptor is versioned so a decision can be replayed and explained months later.
Derived artifacts inherit this descriptor: summaries, embeddings of summaries, extracted entities, graph nodes, cached rewrites.
Every chunk must be independently authorizable. The retrieval unit is the chunk, so the security unit is the chunk.
